import json,collections
r=list(map(json.loads,open('items.jsonl')))
a=list(map(json.loads,open('answers.jsonl')))
for n,s in enumerate(['ъъ','ьъъ','ъь','ь'],70):
 a.append(dict(item_id=r[n]['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):c for i,c in enumerate(s)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(s))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes',note=''))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
a=list(map(json.loads,open('answers.jsonl')))
assert len(a)==len(r)
for x,y in zip(r,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 keys={str(i+1) for i in range(x['slots'])}
 assert set(y['slots'])==keys and set(y['confidence'])==keys
 assert all(c in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for c in y['slots'].values())
 assert all(c in ['high','low'] for c in y['confidence'].values())
 assert y['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(a),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(collections.Counter(c for x in a for c in x['slots'].values())))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in a))
